name: Greater Change Shape (General)
body:
“I have learned the forms of death and power.”

Prerequisite(s): Change shape and moment of change class feature, Improved Change Shape

Benefit(s): you gain access to undead anatomy and geniekind (See Below) for use with your change shape class feature based on your taskshaper class level as shown on the table below. Special: You can take this feat as a shaped capacity so long as you meet its prerequisites.

Table: Greater Change Shape
Class Level	Spell Name
5th	undead anatomy I
9th	geniekind, undead anatomy II
11th	undead anatomy III
15th	undead anatomy IV

The taskshaper has all forms at her disposal, including the undead.

Special: You can choose to take this feat as a shaped capacity ability.
